business_problem: Bally's needed a better way to support omnichannel gaming personalization, compliant analytics, and faster market launches because legacy technology fragmented customer and operational data, which slowed experimentation, delayed product launches, and limited self-service decision making.
solution_summary: Bally's uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support omnichannel gaming personalization, compliant analytics, and faster market launches. The implementation replaced a legacy state where legacy technology fragmented customer and operational data, which slowed experimentation, delayed product launches, and limited self-service decision making. Player activity data and retail casino data move through Lakeflow Jobs and Structured Streaming and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Lakehouse Federation and Serverless compute operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver personalized player experiences and self-service data products.
business_outcome: Bally's improved omnichannel gaming personalization, compliant analytics, and faster market launches with measurable results including 60–70% building a scalable foundation for growth, 30-40% player needs, and 10x serverless compute, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: 60–70% building a scalable foundation for growth
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
60–70% building a scalable foundation for growth
evidence_quotes: Our goal is to make data a capability that every part of the business can leverage, rather than something owned exclusively by technology teams,

The business was moving faster than our operating model could support, which is what ultimately led us to build a self-service platform that enables teams across the organization to operate with greater autonomy.
We now operate from a single data foundation with consistent governance across the enterprise,
That gives us governance and auditability at a level that would have been very difficult to achieve with legacy solutions.
